summary_en: AVANTIA authorized acquisition of up to 350,000 shares (2.41% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of JPY 300 million via ToSTNeT-3 and off-market purchases through October 14, 2026 to January 29, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On October 13, 2026, AVANTIA's board of directors authorized a new share buyback program under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied via Article 165(3)). The company will acquire up to 350,000 ordinary shares for a maximum outlay of JPY 300 million during the period from October 14, 2026 through January 29, 2027. The target acquisition represents 2.41% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, calculated based on the 14,501,044 shares outstanding as of August 31, 2026.

The acquisition will be executed via two methods: self-negotiated off-market transactions using ToSTNeT-3, and market purchases conducted under a discretionary trading agreement. The company cited the dual objectives of improving capital efficiency and executing flexible capital policy in response to changing management conditions.
